--- create_table_constraint_column_and_constraints.sql
CREATE TABLE Probe (
  Id INT64 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT BOOL,
  CONSTRAINT PositiveId CHECK (Id > 0),
  CONSTRAINT ParentId FOREIGN KEY (Id) REFERENCES Parent (Id)
) PRIMARY KEY (Id)

--- SQL
CREATE TABLE Probe (
  Id INT64 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT BOOL,
  CONSTRAINT PositiveId CHECK (Id > 0),
  CONSTRAINT ParentId FOREIGN KEY (Id) REFERENCES Parent (Id)
